summary: Native CountArmyKingdom / SummoningKingdom with a faction kingdom id (3048 Wild Court, 3053 Amanithrax) has no runtime equivalent: Character.kingdom is the zh parent-kingdom name (卜筮之原 / 齐埃金), so alliesOfKingdom counts every Adana / Zaejin ally. Raw data (data/raw/troops.gow.en.json KingdomId) separates them: 3048 = FeyHound, TheWendigo, WildKnight, Puka, RedCap; 3053 = Deathcap(raw-only), Lifecap, KingGobtruffle, Exploadstool, Fungomancer, MushroomMan. Needs a raw kingdom id on Character (or an alliesOfRefs source) so the count matches native.
repro: castSpell({key:'troop:7357', allies:[{kingdom:'卜筮之原', referenceName:'Pegasus'}]}) boosts damage by 4 (native: Pegasus is Adana, not Wild Court -> +0). weapon:1274 same with any Zaejin goblin ally (+3 scatter, +3 explode).

summary: Native CountArmyTroop 7172 Amount 300 + CreateGems Doomskull UseCounterForAmount: 3 Doomskulls PER Eldritch Minion ally. No ModifierSource counts allies by troop (troopPresent is only a boolean condition), so the prototype creates 3 if any minion is present; with 2-3 minions native creates 6-9.
repro: castSpell({key:'troop:7173', allies:[{name:'邪老爪牙'},{name:'邪老爪牙'}]}) creates 3 extra Doomskulls; native 6.

summary: Native CountGems DragonGreen Amount 400: only GREEN Dragon Gems boost the scatter damage. ModifierSource boardSpecial has no colour filter, so the prototype counts Dragon Gems of every colour.
repro: castSpell({key:'weapon:1647', board: withCells(sixColourBoard, {'0,0': dragonGem Blue})}) adds +4; native +0.

summary: TurnEngine.nextCharId / summon.ts deriveCharId = max living id + 1. When the killed unit held the highest id it is spliced out and the next summon REUSES its id, so castTracking.lastTarget (the dead enemy) now resolves to the living summon: later ifTargetDied segments in the same cast fail (7602: 50%/25% Undead summons never fire) and event consumers see one id for two units. Needs a monotonic id allocator.
repro: castSpell({key:'troop:6428', allies:[], enemies:[{}, {hp:5,maxHp:5,armor:0}]}) over 200 seeds: always exactly 1 summon (4 enemies: 1/2/3 = 37/50/13% as native).
